description: Defines socket-related classes and interfaces for network communication, including Socket, Address, Connection, ServerSocket, and ClientSocket within the beerocks::net namespace.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Represents an OS socket resource, extending FileDescriptor, with nested classes for Address and Connection.

classes.name: Socket::Address
classes.description: Abstract class wrapping sockaddr structure, providing methods to access socket address info.

classes.name: Socket::Connection
classes.description: Interface modeling a socket connection, with methods for sending and receiving data.

classes.name: ServerSocket
classes.description: Interface for server-side socket, capable of accepting connections.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Interface for client-side socket, capable of connecting to a server.

methods.name: sockaddr
methods.description: Returns a non-const pointer to sockaddr structure.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns a non-const reference to the sockaddr length.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, returning a new Socket::Connection.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified address.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Receives data from the socket connection.

methods.name: receive_from
methods.description: Receives data from the socket, capturing the sender's address.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends data over the socket connection.

methods.name: send_to
methods.description: Sends data to a specified address.
